LESSON: EVENING PRAYER

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship
Topic 2.1: Evening Prayer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Evening Prayer. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: hown items for your evening prayer?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform evening prayers (6 lessons) devotion for Paramatma
2. name the items required for the various evening prayers
3. appreciate the evening prayers for peace of mind.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. perform evening prayers (6 lessons) devotion for Paramatma
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform evening prayers (6 lessons) devotion for Paramatma. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. name the items required for the various evening prayers
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name the items required for the various evening prayers. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the evening prayers for peace of mind.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the evening prayers for peace of mind. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Evening Prayer.
2. Explain Evening Prayer to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Evening Prayer.
4. Show that you can: perform evening prayers (6 lessons) devotion for Paramatma
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Evening Prayer. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: hown items for your evening prayer?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. perform evening prayers (6 lessons) devotion for Paramatma
2. name the items required for the various evening prayers
3. appreciate the evening prayers for peace of mind.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
